units.prompt: Rebuild ONE complete transparent pixel-game CAVALRY token. INPUT1 is sole master of character identity, armor, hair, helmet, palette, weapons, exact mount species and distinct combat ACTION/lean. INPUT2 is ORIGINAL neutral mounted bones: borrow ONLY rider skull/shoulder/pelvis/knee/ankle lengths, adult rider FIVE anatomical heads crown-to-sole independent of mount. Ordinary skull, small helmet shell, NEVER enlarge head as chibi helmet bubble. Rider has full seated pelvis ON saddle, thighs down mount's flanks, two logical knees/calves/feet and stirrups, coherent weapon grips and reins. Transform BOTH to elevated FRONT camera looking DOWN45–50degrees, crown and shoulder tops obvious; rider head FIRMLY tucked forward/down with eyes mostly hidden under hair/helmet/hood; face only tiny lower fragment. Keep original charge/body lean/sword strike, NO generic upright parade pose. Five heads is anatomical bones before foreshortening, no compressed torso or long 7head hero. Match INPUT2 crisp pixel density, stepped dark outline and short controlled shade ramps. FULL silhouette including lance/sword/banner/tail inside INNER80percent canvas with generous transparent margins; enlarge canvas for wide weapons, NEVER shrink bones to fit gear. Body centered independent of cape and weapons. Absolutely no base/floor/cast-shadow/scenery/text/watermark/extrafigures. Identity 볼그(와르그) (bolg_mounted): EXACT original gear and action. CRITICAL: INPUT1 mount is WARG, NOT HORSE; retain full original wolf muzzle/fangs/fur, four powerful wolf legs and original white or grey color. Ignore INPUT2 horse appearance. Rider ORC muscular width, normal proportionate skull, head bowed.
